name: Compact Earbuds — LED Case with Wrist Strap
description: Small wireless earbuds in a square charging case with a gold-tone edge, an LED display and a braided wrist strap. Comes in black, cream and white.

source.notes: Style "J11 (including lanyard)", ¥13.90. Rate 223.9 ₦/¥ (listing header). Shop confirmed as Huixun by the style picker. Owner set the price (₦7000). Photos are 800 px square, upscaled 1.5x to 1200x1500: slightly soft, check on the review sheet. Strap colour differs by style (black, pink, silver). Do not call these sleep earbuds or claim sleep use: nothing in the photos says so. Not a duplicate of any store earbud. Lithium battery: sea freight only. Owner sent photos with no message; shop, listing, style name and ¥ price unknown. Likely the Shenzhen Huixun listing (offerId 1025659251706, 58.6% return rate) but unconfirmed: if so, samples first and stay unpublished. No Bluetooth version, battery, playtime or waterproofing claimed.

supplier.name: Shenzhen Huixun Electronic Technology Co., Ltd.
